hint.text: A fronted adverbial is always followed by a comma. It describes the action that follows.

instruction.text: Read the text and drag the punctuation to the correct places.

atoms.sound: ssml: Down by the beach, there is a nice ice-cream shop.
atoms.b: Down by the beach((,)) there is a nice ice-cream shop((.))

atoms.sound: ssml: Despite the rain, Milly played outside for hours.
atoms.b: Despite the rain((,)) Milly played outside for hours((.))

atoms.sound: ssml: Every year, we spend the summer with my cousins.
atoms.b: Every year((,)) we spend the summer with my cousins((.))

instruction.text: Rearrange the sentence so that the adverbial phrase is at the start.

atoms.a: The streets began to flood without warning.
I have a big party for New Year’s Eve once a year.
